purpose: Stage-3 string # X 2 S H 4 Y 0 Q B 15 # as leftover-3.2 SHA-256 / OpenSSL passwords. Does not use dbbi or faed. Records the published Phase-2 mappings AND the unsigned 32,42,82,25 tuple the request named, plus worst-gear reversal and the Rotterdam/Decentraland coordinate encodings.
source: Phase 2 AES plaintext (not Phase 3). Already consumed as the Safenet Luna HSM hint that built the 7-part password whose SHA-256 opened phase3.txt.

H.rule: (Answer to only this puzzle but nothing else)*-1 = 42*-1

Q.rule: qwerty fish; digits above I,W on QWERTYUIOP are 8,2

B_alternate.rule: treat i5 as 5, 5^2=25. Drops the imaginary unit the formula writes.

note: YOUR LIFE IS THE SUM OF A REMAINDER OF AN UNBALANCED EQUATION is the Architect line. The phrase 'your sum is' does not appear in the published blobs. 'in case you' is the already-decoded VIC sentence.
